proposals.tactic:
rcases lt_trichotomy m 18 with hm | hm | hm
· have hp : m * n ≤ 17 * 16 := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [h₃] at hp
  norm_num at hp
· exact hm
· have hp : 19 * 16 ≤ m * n := Nat.mul_le_mul (by omega) (by omega)
  rw [h₃] at hp
  norm_num at hp

have hsum : m = n + 2 := by omega
have hp : (n + 2) * n = 288 := hsum ▸ h₃
rcases lt_trichotomy n 16 with hn | hn | hn
· have hbound : (n + 2) * n ≤ 17 * 15 := by
    have hn' : n ≤ 15 := by omega
    have hn'' : n + 2 ≤ 17 := by omega
    gcongr
  rw [hp] at hbound
  norm_num at hbound
· omega
· have hbound : 19 * 17 ≤ (n + 2) * n := by
    have hn' : 17 ≤ n := by omega
    have hn'' : 19 ≤ n + 2 := by omega
    gcongr
  rw [hp] at hbound
  norm_num at hbound

have hpos : 0 < m - n := by simpa [h₂]
have hnm : n ≤ m := le_of_lt (Nat.sub_pos_iff_lt.mp hpos)
have hsum : m = n + 2 := by
  simpa [h₂, Nat.add_comm] using (Nat.sub_add_cancel hnm).symm
rcases lt_trichotomy n 16 with hn | hn | hn
· have hn' : n ≤ 15 := Nat.le_of_lt_succ hn
  have hm' : m ≤ 17 := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right hn' 2
  have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hm' hn'
  rw [h₃] at hp
  norm_num at hp
· norm_num [hsum, hn]
· have hn' : 17 ≤ n := Nat.succ_le_of_lt hn
  have hm' : 19 ≤ m := by
    rw [hsum]
    exact Nat.add_le_add_right hn' 2
  have hp := Nat.mul_le_mul hm' hn'
  rw [h₃] at hp
  norm_num at hp
